in_marathi.name: Kishun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kishun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kishor', which means 'youthful', 'youth', 'man in his prime' or 'powerful'. The name Kishun represents the power, prosperity, and good fortune associated with this stage of life. In Hindu mythology, Kishun is a popular name for both gods and humans.
